quizzes.question: 970 of 1,000 units pass the first test with no rework. What is the First Pass Yield?
quizzes.explanation: FPY = first-pass accepted ÷ total = 970 ÷ 1,000 = 97%. It counts only the units that passed the first time, with no rework.

quizzes.question: An audio line finds reversed speaker polarity on 30 units this shift. What should the team do FIRST?
options: Retrain the operator and carry on
Stop, contain suspect units, then find the root cause
Add a warning label to the speaker
quizzes.explanation: Contain first: stop and hold suspect units back to the last good point. Then find the root cause and prevent it, e.g. with a keyed polarity connector. Blame, labels and extra inspection don't stop it recurring.
